axis.rule: Preserve the certified disposition and distinguish the official amendment's lack of affirmative votes from the later veto of the April draft.
Give the zero exclusion, highest minimum grade and highest sum tiebreak, then give the correct consequence for the checked disposition.
Correctly attribute each delivered package and exact grade. Explicitly identify each unavailable desk instead of guessing its card.

State the number of legal completions and distinguish possible worlds from actual cards. For an unresolved result, identify actual conflicting possible dispositions. For a package or impasse, state what is invariant across completions.
Distinguish the fictional exercise from any official agreement, authority, adoption or commitment.

guard: A materially incorrect or genuinely unclear factual claim fails or makes the guard uncertain. Look for wrong receipts, hidden cards asserted as actual, wrong proof logic, reversed Council outcomes, false authority, and contradictory decision text. Mere omissions reduce criterion points. Require exact candidate spans and supporting field references for all credited units. Judge any additional claim made by a scoped paragraph.
